citations.claim: emergency active while EW yellow truncated
first violating step all-red yellow lasted 4s

counterfactual.change: removed the single emergency event at t=31; prevents preemption of EW yellow and restores normal 6s yellow

explanation: Emergency at t=31 interrupts EW yellow after only 1s before it completed 6s required. This truncated yellow corrupts controller timing, causing subsequent NS yellow (starting step 104) to last only 4s before going all-red at 108, violating yellow_seconds=6. Removing the emergency restores normal timing and no violation.
vision_note: In steps 105-107 the north-south approaches show yellow lights while east-west remains red. At step 108 all approaches are suddenly red, truncating the yellow phase after only about 4 seconds instead of the required 6.
